subject.title: fix(security): narrow sandbox parent to exact active session workspace to prevent cross-agent media read (#107972)

question: Should callers without exact active-session sandbox context intentionally lose all sandbox-media access, or must the exact workspace capability be threaded through every affected caller before the shared parent is removed?
rationale: The safe boundary is clear, but choosing a global fail-closed behavior versus preserving established media workflows requires the media-security owner's explicit contract decision.

options.title: Thread exact context everywhere
options.body: Propagate the active sandbox workspace through all delivery and preview callers, preserving legitimate media while denying sibling workspaces.

options.title: Accept global sandbox denial
options.body: Intentionally deny sandbox media for callers lacking exact context, then document and prove the resulting user-visible workflow change.

options.title: Pause the patch
options.body: Leave the PR open until a canonical session-scoped media capability can be designed without broad roots or silent workflow loss.

recommendation.title: Thread exact context everywhere
recommendation.body: Propagate the active sandbox workspace through all delivery and preview callers, preserving legitimate media while denying sibling workspaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They established and merged the current agent-scoped media authorization contract across the affected delivery surfaces.
